overview_description.description:
Kaagaz is a simple and easy to document scanning & storage app. There is no requirement of Signing In to use Kaagaz Scanner, no irritating Ads, completely free to use and completely offline as well. With Kaagaz Scanner you can have your custom watermark as well.

This app is super useful for students, business owners, professionals or freelance workers. With Kaagaz Scanner even a 10 year old can easily scan papers & documents and share it via email or text.
